_what: What each app's Deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy-<app>.yml) checks before it puts the app on Vercel. projects: which folder deploys to which Vercel project (a folder not listed is never deployed). scope: empty when the projects are on the token owner's own Vercel account; a team's slug when they are in a team (the repo variable VERCEL_SCOPE overrides it). apps: per app, whether its code can run on Vercel yet, which apps must be online before it, and the Production environment variables its projects need (required: deploying stops without them; recommended: it goes ahead and says what's missing; never: deploying stops while it's set). Only the names are checked, never the values.

required.DATABASE_URL: The database's pooled address (Neon: the -pooler address; Supabase: the Transaction pooler, port 6543). For the CRM and Inventory, the base database (…/neondb): each company's is made beside it.
required.ALLOWED_HOSTS: The API's own address as JSON, e.g. ["bishnoi-one-crm-backend.vercel.app"]

never.SHOW_DEMO_ACCOUNTS: Lists the demo accounts and their password on the sign-in page. Delete it from the screens project.

required.PASS_SIGNING_KEY: The key the Platform signs passes with: node scripts/deploy-keys.mjs prints it (secret).

recommended.FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL: The first Platform administrator, made while there are no accounts (with FIRST_ADMIN_NAME and FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD).
recommended.FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Delete it after the first sign-in, then deploy again.

after.bishnoi-platform: Each company must be registered on the Platform before its people can use the CRM, so the Platform's API must be online first.

required.PLATFORM_API_URL: The Platform's API, e.g. https://bishnoi-one-platform-backend.vercel.app (the CRM checks each company there).
required.PLATFORM_PUBLIC_KEY: From node scripts/deploy-keys.mjs (the Platform's /pass/key shows it too).

recommended.PLATFORM_APP_KEY: Its connect key, from the Platform's Connections page (Make its connect key). The Platform then gives it every link and key between the apps, so nothing else about the other apps goes here. Without it, Inventory, Finance and Pharmacy aren't linked.
recommended.CONNECTIONS_KEY: Encrypts what Settings > Connections saves (Zoho, mailboxes). Without it nothing can be connected online.

recommended.NEXT_PUBLIC_BISHNOI_PLATFORM_URL: The Platform's screens: the Sign in with your Bishnoi One account button and Switch company.

bishnoi-in-licensing.name: In-Licensing
bishnoi-in-licensing.not_ready: Its API can't run on Vercel yet: it has no Vercel entry point (backend/app/server.py and [tool.vercel] in pyproject.toml), no Postgres driver (psycopg) and no first-administrator settings. Copy them from bishnoi-crm/backend, add its two Vercel projects to "projects" in .github/deploy.json, and set "ready" to true.
